_meta.notes: The AMENDMENT to the April 7 report: the form checks BOTH the 'April 7' interim box AND the amendment 'Yes', with 'Apr. 14/08' written on the date-of-report line (250-dpi re-render; the second clerk stamp on the page is APR 14 2008, the first APR 07 2008). The signature date is heavily crossed by the signature and reads as '4-4/08' at low confidence. Its Summary Page is IDENTICAL to the original April report (key 28eb76ed) figure-for-figure, so the amendment changed the schedules, not the totals. Line 1 is written with NO separators at all ('62970'), lines 4 and 5 as '62970.' with a trailing period and (line 5) a heavily scribbled-out entry beside it — line5_subtotal is therefore medium confidence. itemized.notes: AMENDMENT to the April 7 report (amendment box ticked Yes, 'Apr 14/08'; the form checks 'April 7 - For the period ending March 31, 2008'). Schedule A spans 2 pages (1 of 2, 2 of 2), Schedule B spans 2 pages (1 of 2, 2 of 2). The Complete Mailing Address column is EMPTY on every Schedule A row - the filer left it blank (on p3 that column is not even ruled into rows) - so donor_city/donor_state are blank throughout; nothing was redacted. Schedule A amounts write cents as a SUPERSCRIPT '00' over a rule and are transcribed with a decimal point. FIVE Schedule A rows are marked in-kind by the words 'in Kind'/'in kind' handwritten OUTSIDE the Amount cell in the right margin (POC Inc. 6,000 + Wasatch Pacific 6,000 + Dewey Reagan 6,000 + Cottonwood Development 6,000 + Jordan Hills Village 4,000 = 28,000), while the mirrored in-kind rows on Schedule B total 26,000 - the filer's own asymmetry, retained, not reconciled. Schedule B row 7's purpose is a ditto mark resolving to the row above. Schedule B rows 9 and 11 have purposes that overflow into the blank table row beneath them, which is why line_no 23 sits in table slot 9 and line_no 24 in table slot 11.
